packageRules.description: One pull request per run for the .NET stack instead of one per package.
GitHub Actions versions land in one pull request.
Reeve SDK and contract pins move as a deliberate sweep, not on the bot schedule.
Major versions of the .NET release train are bumped by hand together with the target framework.
EF Core stays on the major that ships with the target framework: moving it raises every consumer to the next EF Core major, so it is lifted only in the change that decides that.
The .NET SDK major in the workflows moves by hand together with the target framework.
The VersionOverride floors in the shipped projects are the lowest versions consumers need; they are raised by hand only for a feature the library needs.
